brief:
An El Al flight traveling from the United Arab Emirates to Israel diverted to Saudi Arabia after two pilots engaged in a physical altercation in the cockpit, an Israeli official said Monday. The aircraft transmitted emergency signals before landing in the kingdom, according to Al-Monitor.

Details about the nature of the dispute between the pilots and any injuries sustained remain unclear. The incident marks an unusual occurrence on a route that reopened following the 2020 normalization agreement between Israel and the UAE.

title: Israeli pilots fight, divert UAE-Israel flight to Saudi Arabia
